scope.write_rule: write the selected App file at 0x10000 only; do not use a full-project flash map

protected_boundaries.e1_18_assets_baseline: preserve the already accepted E1.18 assets and its shocked.eaf mapping

pre_write_checks: User separately authorizes the hardware step.
Identify the connected ESP32-S3 by read-only chip ID/MAC on the confirmed body port.
Read and hash the current App before writing; retain it as an additional rollback if it differs from the archived O2f2 file.
Read and hash the partition table and E1.18 assets; confirm their boundaries and hashes are unchanged.
Verify the candidate file hash and length against this manifest immediately before writing.
post_write_checks: Read back exactly the written App byte range and compare SHA-256.
Confirm partition table, assets, speech model and NVS were not written or erased.
Keep the boot log and record reset reason and first UI readiness.
Run the approved regression: display, menu, click-to-talk, conversation, menu during/after speech, touch, sleep/wake, DOA and expression behavior.
Only after user acceptance may the deployment status be changed from prepared to accepted.
status_notes: This manifest is an offline review artifact; it is not a flashing command.
The enabled build is not byte-identical to the accepted O2f2 App; the rollback file is retained and hash-verified.
The observer records SetEmotion call entry only. It does not prove resource loading, LCD playback or motor completion.
